name: @rbxts/surge
description: Drop-in-ergonomic alternative to flamework-binary-serializer: specialized serialize/deserialize code generated per shape at TypeScript compile time.

scripts.lint:check: npm run lint:eslint && npm run lint:md
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:eslint -- --fix && npm run lint:md -- --fix
scripts.bench:prepare: npm run tests:install && npm run tests:compile
scripts.bench:size: npm run bench:prepare && npm run bench:size --prefix tests && prettier --write docs/benchmarks/size.md
scripts.bench:size:only: npm run bench:prepare && npm run bench:size:only --prefix tests --
scripts.bench:speed: npm run bench:prepare && npm run bench:speed --prefix tests && prettier --write docs/benchmarks/speed.md
scripts.bench:speed:only: npm run bench:prepare && npm run bench:speed:only --prefix tests --
scripts.dev:tests: npm run compile && npm run tests:compile && concurrently --raw --kill-others "npm:tests:compile:watch" "npm:tests:serve"
scripts.bench:speed:render: npm run bench:speed:render --prefix tests && prettier --write docs/benchmarks/speed.md

author: travddm
